keyframes.title: Gravitational Focus
keyframes.rule: Sun exerts centripetal gravitational pull on orbital path.

keyframes.title: Perihelion Acceleration
keyframes.rule: Planetary velocity peaks at closest approach (Kepler's 2nd Law).

keyframes.title: Harmonic Orbital Period
keyframes.rule: Completed elliptical cycle back to starting aphelion.

subtitles.en: The Sun sits at the focal center, pulling planets into elliptical orbits.
subtitles.es: El Sol se encuentra en el centro focal, atrayendo a los planetas a órbitas elípticas.

subtitles.en: At perihelion closest approach, orbital speed reaches its maximum.
subtitles.es: En el perihelio, la velocidad orbital alcanza su punto máximo.
